enableAutoTracking.name: Auto-disengage on movement
enableAutoTracking.hint: If enabled, tokens that move further than the disengage distance from an engaged opponent automatically lose that engagement. Disable if you prefer purely manual control.

autoDisengageDistance.name: Minimum auto-disengage distance (yards)
autoDisengageDistance.hint: Floor for the auto-disengage threshold. The actual threshold is the maximum of this value and the longer of the two combatants' equipped weapon reaches (Very Long = 4 yds, Massive = 6 yds, all others = 2 yds per Core p.297). Default 2 yards.

skirmishStaleSeconds.name: Skirmish engagement TTL (seconds)
skirmishStaleSeconds.hint: When attacks happen outside an active Combat Tracker session, engagements expire after this many real-time seconds without further attacks. Set to 0 to disable wall-clock pruning. Default 60. (In-combat engagements are pruned by round per Core p.159 regardless.)

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Log engagement state changes and outnumbering calculations to the console.

enableMovementTrigger.name: Prompt on movement that breaks engagement
enableMovementTrigger.hint: If enabled, when an engaged token tries to move out of an opponent's reach, a dialog appears offering Drop Advantage / Roll Dodge / Flee / Cancel. Movement that stays within all engaged opponents' reaches is not interrupted. Disable for fully manual control via the Token HUD buttons.

hud.disengageTooltip: Disengage from opponents (Drop Advantage or Roll Dodge)
hud.fleeTooltip: Flee combat (free attacks, then Fleeing condition)
